tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE cache_entries (
    hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    token_count INTEGER,
    file_size INTEGER,
    created_at REAL DEFAULT (julianday('now'))
, model_key TEXT, kind INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, chain_id TEXT, companion_key TEXT, companion_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, replay_chunk_size INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE cache_meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE legacy_companions (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, modified REAL NOT NULL)
